messages:
Alex W: Quick sync — we need to lock copy for our website pages (Hosted API / Dedicated / Private deployment) before the webinar next Wed. Main asks: hero lines, 2ndary benefit bullets, and inbound lead routing. Anyone got final takes?
Maya K: On it. I'll push new hero alternatives in the doc. My priority is clarity: one-liner that says who it's for + what they get. Avoid internal product jargon.
Rob S: +1. For Dedicated page we should call out SLAs and reserved capacity early. Suggest hero: "Predictable inference throughput with SLA-backed GPU pools". Thoughts?
Chloe P: Love that. For Hosted, keep it friendly: "Deploy in minutes, scale with confidence". Also need a short benchmark blurb — can we surface the 99th pctl latency numbers?
Alex W: Yes — include a small benchmark line under hero for Hosted: "Typical gen latency 100–200ms (8k context) on our hosted models". Need ops/telemetry approval on numbers.
Rob S: I'll ping eng-telemetry for a verified stat. @marketing-bot, tag me when the doc is updated :point_down:
marketing-bot: Rob S, I added a reminder to the copy doc: https://docs.redwood.com/marketing/copy/northstar-pages
Maya K: For inbound routing, proposal: three CTAs — "Try Hosted", "Book Dedicated", "Request Private deployment". Map these to different forms & lead flows. Do we have routing rules?
Chloe P: Routing suggestion: low-usage -> Hosted trial auto-nurture; mid-enterprise -> AE qualification; high-security -> send to Private sales slack channel + compliance form. I'll draft mapping.
Alex W: Nice. Please capture as a small table in the doc. Also, webinar landing: can we reuse Hosted hero but add "Join our webinar to see benchmarks and live Q&A" CTA
Maya K: I'll build the webinar snippet and a short registration flow that pre-fills company size -> routes to AE vs nurture.
Rob S: Quick wording tweak — avoid using the shorthand "Private" alone; prefer "Private deployment (VPC/on-prem)". Less ambiguous for legal/procurement.
Chloe P: Agreed. Also propose a tiny FAQ accordion: "Which mode for regulated data?" -> Private deployment. "How do I save on token costs?" -> Redwood Optimize tips.
Alex W: Great. Timeline: Maya to produce final hero variants by EOD tomorrow, Rob to confirm benchmarks by EOD, Chloe to map routing & forms. We'll review in async doc and reconvene if blockers. :thumbsup:
Maya K: ack, will tag when done
Rob S: ack, pinging infra now
Chloe P: will draft routing + snippets
Alex W: Thanks all — assigning follow-ups in doc.
